sn34.9:1.4: Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī || || 5
sn34.9:1.5: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo || || 6
sn34.9:1.6: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti || na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī || || 7
sn34.9:1.7: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī ca || || 8
sn34.9:1.8: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyam jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī ca || ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnam aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca || || 9
